custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 5 on hand.
  • Create a vendor return for this test, return A, for part A to any vendor, saved and not completed.
  • Create a vendor return for this test, return B, for part A to any vendor, completed (accepted by the vendor).
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425699 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425699-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 5. Click Save.
  2. Make a return for part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then Create Return. Pick any vendor under Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425699-A in Part Number and pick it. Type 1 in Quantity. Click Save Return.
  3. Complete that return: On the Returns list tick that return's row and click Receive Credit. Type any Credit Memo Number, pick a Credit Date, then click Post Credit.
